overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when a quorum discussed the Town Accountant appointment with the Town Administrator outside a noticed meeting, and that the March 22 open-session discussion did not cure it.

allegations.summary: A quorum of the three-member Board allegedly met with the Town Administrator about the Town Accountant position outside a properly noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing the matter outside of a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: The Board argued its March 22 open-session discussion cured any February 11 violation; the AG rejected this defense.
allegations.key_passage: This discussion addressed the February 11 meeting, not the Town Accountant vacancy which was the original topic that was improperly discussed at the unnoticed meeting.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

Create minutes for the February 11 meeting to the best of the Board's ability, through whatever means are available, including the memories and individual notations of the attendees, within 60 days of receipt of the letter, and certify compliance to the AG in writing.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
